translationRepairs: On rennwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager.
On renwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager.
The sexagenary day renwu has one n; the current idiomatic field has a typographical error.
On rennwu day, honored mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager.
On renwu day, honored mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager.
The literal field contains the same misspelling of renwu.
On renshen day the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her.
On renshen day the Emperor visited the tent containing the spirit tablets; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and she too was ordered to bow before them.
Lady Xiao, not the emperor, is the understood subject of the second clause; bowing before the tablets states the reference clearly.
On renshen day, the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her.
On renshen day, the Emperor visited the spirit-tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and she too was ordered to bow before the tablets.
The literal field reverses the subject and object of the order; the revision removes the resulting pronoun ambiguity.
In the first year of Chongqing, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
In the first year of Chongxi, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
The era name is Chongxi, not Chongqing.
A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongqing.
A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongxi.
The source explicitly changes the era name to Chongxi.
General amnesty; changed era name to Chongqing.
General amnesty; changed era name to Chongxi.
The literal field has the same incorrect era-name reading.
In the first year of Chongqing, spring, first month, on the renshen new moon, the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
In the first year of Chongxi, spring, first month, on the renshen new moon, the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
The literal field must likewise read Chongxi.
Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong was appointed Associate Councilor of State.
Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhan was appointed Associate Councilor of State.
Tong begins the office title and is not part of Yelü Qiuhan's name; retaining 'of State' preserves the established English office rendering.
Made Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong Associate Councilor of State.
Made Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhan Associate Councilor of State.
The literal field has the same fused personal name; 'of State' is retained for consistency.
On renchen day Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute.
On renchen day Jurchen xiangwen Taiya led his followers to come with tribute.
The verb 'led' was fused into Taiya's name; the proposed idiomatic sentence restores the grammar.
On renchen day, Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute.
On renchen day, Jurchen xiangwen Taiya led his troops to come with tribute.
The literal field contains the same fused-name error.
